name: F1® 25
summary: Codemasters 开发、Electronic Arts 发行的赛车模拟，2025 年 5 月 30 日上市。商店 AI 披露是 Steam 通用勾选句式：“生成式 AI 可能用于制作本作的预渲染或实时生成内容，且全部内容都是人工主导的创作结果”，没有点名任何学科；八个领域全部记为披露未说明，并标记为范围未说明。

sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: Generative AI may have been used in creating pre-rendered or live-generated content for this game. All such content is the result of a human-led artistic and creative process.

sources.label: Steam 讨论区首页核查
sources.excerpt: 英文讨论区首页显示 15 个主题（总数 276）；仅覆盖首页。

sources.label: Steam AI Filter 本作页逐字复刻商店披露
sources.excerpt: The developer of F1® 25 disclosed AI-generated content on its Steam store page: “Generative AI may have been used in creating pre-rendered or live-generated content for this game. All such content is the result of a human-led artistic and creative process.”

reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 Codemasters，发行商 Electronic Arts）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 276），首页没有与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 1 篇原始来源（Steam AI Filter 本作页逐字复刻商店披露的句式，属转录，不构成独立核实）。其余结果全部是本作商店页及其荷兰语、简体中文、罗马尼亚语版本与一篇 Steam 六月畅销榜汇总新闻，没有针对本作 AI 使用的报道。商店披露只有这两句 EA 通用句式，用词是“may have been used”，既未点名美术、配音、文案等学科，也未说明预渲染或实时生成具体指什么内容，因此八个领域一律不使用“已使用”，本条按“范围未说明”登记。结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
disclosureQuote: Generative AI may have been used in creating pre-rendered or live-generated content for this game. All such content is the result of a human-led artistic and creative process.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-11-03 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: The store disclosure for F1® 25 is Steam's generic checkbox wording: generative AI may have been used in creating pre-rendered or live-generated content and all such content is the result of a human-led artistic and creative process. No development discipline is named, so all eight areas are recorded as not addressed and the scope is flagged as unspecified.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer Codemasters, publisher Electronic Arts) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 276); no homepage topic directly concerns AI use and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 1 raw source was read: a Steam AI Filter page reproducing the boilerplate wording verbatim, which is a transcription and not independent verification. The remaining results were the store page in English, Dutch, Simplified Chinese and Romanian plus a Steam monthly bestseller roundup, none of which reports on this game's AI use. The disclosure is only these two sentences of generic wording, hedged with may have been used, naming no discipline and not saying what pre-rendered or live-generated content refers to, so no area is recorded as used and the scope is flagged as unspecified. The finding rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit.
